title: Build a release brief
author: TriunaLabs
origin: Original TriunaLabs workflow substantially upgraded with deterministic Git evidence collection, report rendering, fixtures, and tests.

preview.alt: Interactive release brief showing immutable Git range metrics, categorized changes, release risks, and evidence gaps.

requirements: Python 3.10+, Git, and read access to a local repository. Issue, test, deployment, rollback, and limitation evidence is optional but must be supplied explicitly when used. HTML reports run in a modern browser with JavaScript enabled.
examples: Build an interactive release brief for v1.2.0..v1.3.0 for application users and show every evidence gap.
Create developer-facing Markdown release notes from these two commit SHAs and attach the supplied test and deployment evidence.
Review this release range for breaking changes, migrations, configuration changes, and missing rollback evidence without publishing anything.
